Planning appeals procedural guide pre April 2026

official_measurement_examples.name: Conditions bind implementation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Development must be carried out in accordance with the planning permission and its conditions; a permission is not unconditional simply because it has been granted.

official_measurement_examples.name: Section 73 scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Section 73 can vary or remove conditions but cannot change the operative description of development and is not a complete re-determination of the original proposal.

official_measurement_examples.name: New independent permission
official_measurement_examples.fact: A grant under section 73 creates a new independent permission alongside the original permission rather than rewriting the original decision.

official_measurement_examples.name: Original remains
official_measurement_examples.fact: The original planning permission remains intact after a section 73 decision unless separately affected; applicants must track which permission they implement.

official_measurement_examples.name: Discharge requires formal approval
official_measurement_examples.fact: Where a condition requires details to be approved, submission alone is not discharge; formal written approval of the condition details is required.

official_measurement_examples.name: Pre-commencement distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Pre-commencement conditions require compliance before works start unless the statutory exceptions or written-agreement rules apply.

official_measurement_examples.name: EIA interaction
official_measurement_examples.fact: A section 73 application can trigger fresh EIA screening or updated environmental information where the EIA Regulations apply.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Condition discharge or section 73 status does not establish land ownership access infrastructure capacity or final development yield.

core_rules: planning permission remains subject to conditions
formal approval evidence is required where condition demands approval
section73 changes conditions not development description
section73 permission is new and independent
section96A and section73 are distinct routes
planning obligation variation is distinct from condition variation
EIA duties can re-engage on section73
appeal procedure depends on application date
condition compliance is not land ownership
condition discharge does not calculate parcel yield
no parcel condition-clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
